$$r_2^2+r_3^2+r_4^2=\sum r_i^2-r_1^2=-r_1^2,$$
and similarly for the other terms. Since $p(0)=3\neq 0$, no root is zero, so $r_i^2\neq 0$ and every denominator is nonzero.

$$\frac{r_i^2}{-r_i^2}=-1.$$
